android.desc:
This watchface is based on particle systems: streams of "tachyon particles" shoot out from the center to form the hour, minute, and second hands. A delightful Wear OS watch face that will be sure to catch the eye of any passerby. 

Tap the center to change the styling and colors. Infinite styles and palettes are generated by genetic algorithms.

Tap the top left to toggle between filled particles to hollow ones.

--------

This is a beta watchface; please email me with any feedback before you leave a rating; I'm always glad to help. Thanks!

quotes.text:
I made about $10 from app sales of my Android Wear watchfaces https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.odbol.fountainoftime.wear and https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.odbol.oxwoodwatchface.wear

$10... For the whole year. App sales aren't the golden goose everyone things they are.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What was your best passive income in 2016?
